# cppcheck can't see Unreal Engine headers since we don't check out the
# engine in CI, so it will flag every #include of Core Minimal / engine
# headers as missing. That's expected noise, not a real issue - suppress it.
missingInclude
missingIncludeSystem

# UE's reflection macros and generated headers confuse cppcheck's parser
# in ways the -D defines in the workflow don't fully cover. Suppress the
# noisiest categories here; remove individual lines as you tune this over
# time and start trusting the signal.
unknownMacro
unmatchedSuppression

# .generated.h files are UHT output we never generate in this workflow
# (no engine build), so cppcheck will always complain they're missing.
# This suppresses that specific complaint by file pattern.
missingInclude:*.generated.h
